text:
isabel_sales: Quick sync thread for MercadoCore POC. They want: (A) EU-only processing + cache for EU tenants even during failover; (B) full subprocessor list + cert links for Sao Paulo; (C) whether support engineers ever access EU data from non-EU IPs; (D) rough hosted vs dedicated delta for 200 & 600 RPS.

tom_se: Short answer: yes we can enforce EU-only with tenant_pin + failover_mode=region_fallback_only + on_no_eu_capacity=reject. That returns 503 if no EU capacity.

andrew_infra: Sao Paulo subprocessors: GCP (sa-east1) - compliance page: https://gcp.example/sa-east1, LogPipe (logs in-region, SOC2: https://logpipe.example/soc2), MetricHub (metrics, ISO27001: https://metricshub.example/iso27001). We can export CSV with contact + cert links. Note: we don't have a BR-dedicated cluster; hosted runs in sa-east1 for LATAM.

sara_privacy: On support access: we can restrict engineer console access to an EU IP allowlist for the tenant, with mandatory approval flow for any cross-region access. All sessions are logged and auditable. We'll add that language to the DPA addendum.

ricardo_customer: They also want to know whether KV cache shards ever sync to US under normal operations.

tom_se: Cache semantics: primary KV cache is local to serving region when tenant_pin=true. Cross-region replication occurs only if on_no_eu_capacity=allow_cross_region or during explicit DR ops initiated by infra. For POC we can set backups & snapshots to EU-only.

isabel_sales: Can you paste a routing snippet + curl to create the tenant for the POC? I'll send to legal.

tom_se: Routing snippet (POC):
```
routing_policy:
  allowed_regions: ["eu-west-1","eu-central-1"]
  tenant_pin: true
  failover_mode: "region_fallback_only"
  on_no_eu_capacity: "reject"
```
Curl:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/tenants \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"tenant_id":"mercadocore-eu","region_pin":"eu-west-1","routing_policy":{"failover_mode":"region_fallback_only","on_no_eu_capacity":"reject"}}'
```

andrew_infra: Pricing sketch: Hosted with tenant_pin = same per-token billing; we can reserve transient capacity for POC windows (+~10-20% uplift). Dedicated sketches: ~ $26k/mo for 200 RPS baseline, ~ $90k/mo for 600 RPS (dependent on model family). Sales will produce formal quote.

sara_privacy: Action items: I'll draft LGPD addendum and support-access clause.

andrew_infra: Action: export subprocessor CSV + cert links for sa-east1 and attach SOC2/ISO docs.

tom_se: I'll validate the reject behavior in staging and post back with test results within 2 hours.

ci-bot: POC org created: redwood-poc-mercadocore-1945001234. Endpoint: https://eu.api.redwood.ai/poc/mercadocore-eu. Credentials stored in vault.

ricardo_customer: Thanks team. Will review CSV + DPA draft and confirm whether they need vendor attestations for LogPipe.

isabel_sales: I'll email the customer once we have CSV + DPA draft + routing snippet. Target EOD.
(End of thread)
